fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld+html) combine fields resolved from the page's AIOSEO @graph JSON-LD block with the full article body scraped from HTML. Latest-mode records (S2-rss) carry title/link-style fields from the site-wide RSS feed.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-jsonld+html or S2-rss).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline (article mode, from the JSON-LD Article node).

description.title: Description
description.description: Short article description/dek (article mode, from <meta name="description">, falling back to the JSON-LD WebPage node).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text, scraped from the HTML content area (article mode only -- the JSON-LD does not carry articleBody on this site).

author.title: Author
author.description: Byline name (article mode) -- resolved from the JSON-LD Person node the Article's author reference points to; comma-joined if more than one.

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Publisher organization name (article mode) -- resolved from the JSON-LD Organization node, falling back to <meta property="og:site_name">.

articleSection.title: Section
articleSection.description: Comma-separated categories and tags (article mode, raw passthrough from JSON-LD -- not a clean single category).

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline from the RSS item (latest mode).

category.title: Category
category.description: First RSS <category> value on the item (latest mode).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
